payload.text: Yesterday I went to the campus library to finish an assignment with a friend. We found a table near the window, but the room was louder than we expected. I started by reading my notes and marking the parts that still confused me. My friend suggested working through one example before trying the whole problem. That helped because I could see where I had skipped an important step. After an hour we took a short break and walked outside for some fresh air. When we returned, I checked my answers again and wrote down two questions to ask during the next class. This was study session number 1.
